_comment: Project-level Claude Code hooks for the new-project template. Replace [PROGRESS_PATH] with the real project path when needed.

PreToolUse._comment: H1: block dangerous Bash patterns: git hook bypass, force push to main, protected recursive deletes, chained checkout/merge pipes, and AI merge to main.

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null || true); MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit[[:space:]]+(commit|push|merge|rebase|stash|tag|cherry-pick|am|revert)\b.*(--no-verify|--no-gpg-sign|-c[[:space:]]+commit\.gpgsign=false)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: git hook bypass is forbidden. Fix the underlying issue."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+push.*-f.*\\b(main|$MAIN_BRANCH)\\b"; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: force-push to the main branch is forbidden."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]*(\.claude|docs|migrations)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: recursive delete of protected directories (.claude/docs/migrations)."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(checkout|switch|merge|rebase|reset)\b.*\|[[:space:]]*(tail|head|awk)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: chained pipe can hide git checkout/merge failures. Use separate commands."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+merge\b' && { [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" = "$MAIN_BRANCH" ] || echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+(checkout|switch)[[:space:]]+$MAIN_BRANCH([[:space:]]|&&|;|$)"; }; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: merge to main is human-only. Ask the human to run it manually."}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

PreToolUse._comment: H2-pre: before a sprint no-ff merge, warn if the source branch last commit does not touch progress.md.

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null || true); MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+merge[[:space:]]+--no-ff[[:space:]]+$MAIN_BRANCH\\."; then SPRINT_BRANCH=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oE "$MAIN_BRANCH\\.[^[:space:]\"']+" | head -1); if [ -n "$SPRINT_BRANCH" ]; then LAST_FILES=$(git log -1 --name-only --pretty=format: "$SPRINT_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$'); if ! echo "$LAST_FILES" | grep -qiE '(^|/)progress\.md$'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"Pre-merge check: sprint branch last commit does not touch progress.md. Update progress.md as the final sprint commit unless this is an intentional exception."}'; exit 0; fi; fi; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

PostToolUse._comment: H2-post: after sprint no-ff merge, warn if merged files did not include progress.md.

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null || true); MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+merge[[:space:]]+--no-ff[[:space:]]+$MAIN_BRANCH\\."; then LAST_FILES=$(git log -1 --name-only --pretty=format: HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$'); if ! echo "$LAST_FILES" | grep -qiE '(^|/)progress\.md$'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"Merge completed without progress.md changes. If this was not intentional, open a chore.progress branch to repair the progress record."}'; exit 0; fi; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

SessionStart._comment: H5: load enabled project agents from .claude/agents/.enabled with quiet output.
H6: print one short work-state line. Keep this concise because hook output enters context.

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" 2>/dev/null; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count origin/$MAIN_BRANCH..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); PROGRESS_PATH="[PROGRESS_PATH]"; if [ "$PROGRESS_PATH" = "[PROGRESS_PATH]" ] || [ ! -f "$PROGRESS_PATH" ]; then PROGRESS_PATH=$(find . -maxdepth 3 -iname 'progress.md' 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; LINES=$(wc -l < "$PROGRESS_PATH" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); OPEN=$(gh issue list --state open 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0); echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Branch: $BRANCH | ahead main: $AHEAD | open issues: $OPEN | progress lines: $LINES\"}"; exit 0

SessionEnd._comment: H7: write local session memory without model calls or context injection.
